unresolvedReferences.description: The heading punctuation treats Xiu Lie as Yu Zhining's great-grandson and Ao and Cong as his fourth- and fifth-generation descendants. Yizhi and Changzong are clansmen of Zhang Xingcheng. Surnames are not added beyond the packet's English.
周 and 召 are rendered Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao. Those packet renderings are kept; no other names are supplied.
太子 before Chengqian is named in s0020, and the later unnamed crown prince, are treated as Chengqian. Strongly inferred from this biography.
貞觀三年 is not Liao Taiping, the only reign in this chapter's packet table, so it is not converted.
帝 in s0043 and s0067, and 'the emperor' supplied in s0048, are not named. They are not identified with Taizong or with Gaozong.
The Prince of Jin who became crown prince is not identified with Gaozong. The packet does not give him a personal name.
紇幹承基 is kept as Qigan Chengji, the packet's rendering.
內史過 is kept as Inner Scribe Guo, the packet's rendering.
四年 is kept as written. The era is not filled in from Yonghui or Xianqing.
諡曰定 is the posthumous title Ding, not a person.
The emperor who discusses the Materia Medica is not named in this chunk and is not identified with Gaozong.
The emperor who says 'Well said' after Pei Guangting is treated as Xuanzong, who ordered the copying in s0088. Strongly inferred.
The emperor who questions Xiu Lie, and the emperor of s0123 and s0129, are treated as Suzong. Strongly inferred after s0115.
The emperor who honors Xiu Lie's wife and sighs at his death is treated as Daizong. Strongly inferred after s0130.
李當之 is rendered Li Dang. The packet English is kept.
湯 is rendered Tang. That is the packet's English, not a dynasty name.
會稽賀朝萬齊融 is kept as He Chao and Wan Qirong, the packet's split.
珪 and 瑰 are both rendered Gui. They are kept as two people, distinguished only by the Chinese characters.
宣宗 is rendered Xuanzong. That is the packet's English; it is not changed to distinguish 玄宗.
帝 at the meal is treated as the Xuanzong of s0167. Strongly inferred.
高馮 is rendered Gao Feng, known as Jifu. Earlier chunks of this chapter render the heading name Gao Jifu. This chunk's rendering is kept.
夷 and 惠 are rendered Bo Yi and Liu Xiahui. Those packet English names are kept.
八年 is kept as written. The era is not filled in from Xiantong.
帝 in s0204 and s0205, after Taizong praises the memorial, is treated as Taizong. Strongly inferred.
帝 in s0225, s0227, s0230, s0235, s0240, s0242, and s0244, and the emperor in s0241, before Gaozong takes the throne, is treated as Taizong. Strongly inferred.
帝 in s0247, s0253, and s0258, after Gaozong takes the throne, is treated as Gaozong. Strongly inferred.
The crown prince stationed at Dingzhou is not named. He is not identified with Gaozong, nor with the crown prince of s0288.
The crown prince who asks that Changzong be made king is not named. He is a different person from the crown prince at Dingzhou.

舜、禹、湯、武、稷、蒐、伊、呂、蕭、曹、韓、彭 are kept under the packet's English: Shun, Yu, Tang, Wu, Ji, Sou, Yi, Lü, Xiao, Cao, Han, and Peng. Han in this list is the person 韓. Zhou and Han in s0232 are polities, not people.
是歲 is kept as written. The era is not filled in.
諡曰定 is the posthumous title Ding, not a person.
母韋 and 母臧 are two women, both enfeoffed as grand ladies. They are not collapsed into one mother. 希臧 is their father Xizang, not the mother Zang.
五郎 and 六郎 are nicknames of Yizhi and Changzong, not further people. 諸武兄弟 are a collective, not one named person.
王子晉後身 means reincarnation of Prince Zijin. 後身 is not a reference to Empress Wu. The empress is 後使 and 媚後 in this unit, and 後 in s0286 and s0288. 後為 in s0217 and 後每 in s0284 are not the empress.
後 through this narrative is treated as Empress Wu, who is named in s0311. Strongly inferred from the continuous account of the Yizhi brothers.
天子, the emperor who is called old, is not named. He is not identified with Gaozong or Taizong. The crown prince he is to be set beside is not named.
The 皇太子 welcomed in during Shenlong 1 is not named. He is treated as the same unnamed crown prince as 太子 in s0290, not as Crown Prince Chengqian. Strongly inferred.
其後 is 'afterward', not Empress Wu. 後旨 in the same unit is the empress.
已而後 is read with the packet English, which makes the empress the one who was long ill.
恐後不諱 is the empress's death, not a second person.
Tongxiu is named beside elder brother Changyi, but the packet does not give Tongxiu his own kinship term.
其兄昌期 and 從弟景雄: 其 follows the execution of both Yizhi and Changzong. The elder brother and younger cousin are linked to Yizhi, the first named. That link is inferred from the pronoun.
李邕 is rendered Li Yong. That packet English is kept. He is not identified with any other Li Yong.
季輔 is rendered Jifu, as this unit writes it. 行成 is Xingcheng. No further names are added.
神龍元年 and, in s0309, 天寶九載 are kept as written. They are not in the packet reign table.
